breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the factor-of-safety condition as P_cr ≥ n·P (i.e., P_req = n·P = 60000 N), which matches the ground truth. It explicitly states 'Interpret the buckling safety requirement as P_cr ≥ n·P' and does not use the incorrect P/n formulation from the incomplete prompt.
